basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Scientist III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) post in the ICMR-sponsored project PRAGATICAR (Project Code – R/CIH). The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 78,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the selection process.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy

PRAGATICAR: Centre for Advanced Research on Frugal Diagnostics, Regenerative and Personalised Healthcare, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Health, Advanced Therapeutics, Translational Innovation, and Inclusive Healthcare (Project Code – R/CIH)
12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to Rs. 78,000 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PG Degree, including integrated PG degree, with 5 years post-qualification experience; OR PhD with 2 years post-qualification experience. For Engineering/IT/CS: 4-year Graduate Degree with 5 years experience; OR PG with 3 years experience; OR PhD. Senior technology-development leadership. AI/ML, medical devices, imaging, biosensors, multidisciplinary technology translation. Project leadership/PI or Co-PI experience is highly desirable. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum. Mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 78,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The assignment is temporary and lasts 12 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earlier. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notice states that any application fee is to be deposited through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc. into the State Bank of India (00202) account named IIT SRIC-OM Account, Account No. 39502115210, IFSC SBIN0000202, SWIFT SBININBB339, at P.O. Kharagpur Technology, Dist. Midnapore, West Bengal – 721302.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur Project Research Scientist-III recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) in the Department of Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 9 December 2026. The advertisement is dated 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A PG Degree (including integrated PG) with 5 years post-qualification experience, or a PhD with 2 years. For Engineering/IT/CS: a 4-year Graduate Degree with 5 years experience, or PG with 3 years, or a PhD.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 78,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice lists the fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the tenure, and is the job permanent?
faq.answer: The job is not permanent. It is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project, lasting 12 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which project and funding agency is the post under?
faq.answer: The post is under the project PRAGATICAR (Project Code – R/CIH), sponsored by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). Prof./Dr. Suman Chakraborty is the PI/Co-PI.

faq.question: Q10. Does meeting the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
